attractions.name: Tirta Ganga Water Palace
attractions.description: Once the royal water palace of Karangasem, featuring elegant fountains, koi-filled ponds, stone pathways, and beautifully landscaped gardens. One of East Bali's most picturesque landmarks.

attractions.name: Lempuyang Temple (Gates of Heaven)
attractions.description: Sacred temple complex perched on the slopes of Mount Lempuyang, home to Bali's famous 'Gates of Heaven'. On clear mornings, Mount Agung perfectly frames the temple gates creating one of the island's most iconic views.
